item.command: "C:\\Users\\25634\\.cache\\codex-runtimes\\codex-primary-runtime\\dependencies\\native\\powershell\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$configText = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath config.json; $fixedText = $configText.Replace('"'[\"id\", \"amount\"]', '[\"id\", \"amount\"],') -replace '\"mode\": \"gt\",', '\"mode\": \"gt\"'; "'$config = $fixedText | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($config.mode -ne '"'gt') { throw 'Unsupported mode' }; "'$ids = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath data.csv | Where-Object { [decimal]$_.amount -gt [decimal]$config.threshold } | ForEach-Object { $_.id }); $utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'config.json'), "'$fixedText, $utf8); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'result.md'), (("'$ids -join "`n") + "`n"), $utf8); $report = "发现并修复两处 JSON 语法损坏：`n`n1. 第 3 行，columns 字段的数组结尾缺少逗号：在 ] 后补上逗号，以分隔后续 mode 字段。`n2. 第 4 行，mode 字段末尾存在尾随逗号：删除该逗号，使最后一个字段符合 JSON 语法。`n`n已将修复写回 config.json，并成功解析。threshold = 10，mode = gt；保留 amount > 10 的行，共 3 行。`n"; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'error_report.md'), "'$report, $utf8); Get-Content -Raw result.md; Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 error_report.md'
